name: Clock of Reincarnation
description:
An item that extends the expired store pet's rental period by 4 weeks. Mysterious power lies in the clock of reincarnation that has the ability to restore time.

**How To Use**
Affect is applied in the instant of use. Must be level 5 or higher to use.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
